title: Read an SGLang sweep on an L4
summary: Use real SGLang runs on an NVIDIA L4 to find the saturation point, the SLO limit, the FP8 gain and the effect of a smaller prefill chunk.

mutants.absolute_gain: Compares the absolute difference of throughput with min_gain, not the relative gain.
mutants.median_ttft_for_slo: Tests the SLO against the median TTFT, not the p99 TTFT.
mutants.pct_over_new: Divides the change by the new value, not by the old value.
mutants.returns_next_level: Returns the level after the low gain step, not the level before it.
mutants.strict_limit: Uses a strict less than, so a value equal to the limit fails the SLO.
mutants.strict_overlap: Uses strict comparisons, so ranges that touch at one point do not overlap.
